name: independent-restore-wrong-key
reviewer: Independent reviewer (Claude Opus 5 CLI documentation review seat)

steps.action: A wrong credential key on the restored target
steps.actual: With a different OPENLAW_SECRET_KEY supplied to the restored target, all 5 restored Contracts still read normally, but the saved relay was not usable: GET /email-settings reported source "unset" and the test send failed with HTTP 502 and the detail "The test email could not be sent. SMTP is not configured — save a relay first.". Nothing reached the controlled mailbox.
